architecture.description: How the tribe builds its homes, temples, schools, markets and the ruler's house.

material.description: What the walls are built of. Only the materials the facts allow for the tribe's age.

wall.description: Palette index for the walls, from the walls list.

roof_color.description: Palette index for the roofs, from the roofs list.

trim.description: Palette index for doors, bands and details, from the trim list.

towers.description: Towers on the temple, the school and the ruler's house.

proportion.description: Low and wide, ordinary, or tall and narrow.

fashion.description: What the people wear. Each class is a palette index for its clothes.

commoner.description: Ordinary people's clothes, from the cloth or drab list.

noble.description: Nobles' clothes, from the cloth or bright list.

bonded.description: The bonded's clothes, from the drab list.

guard.description: Guards' clothes or uniform, from the cloth or drab list.

trim.description: Bands, borders and accessories, from the trim list.

pattern.description: Pattern woven into the clothes, in the trim color.

accessory.description: What ordinary people wear with it.
